postprocess_config.radius_limit: Single engineering threshold; original paper runtime units are not fully traceable
postprocess_config.normalization: NONE; never normalize the generated bbox
postprocess_config.known_vertex_identity: FP32 coordinate bytes, including signed zero
postprocess_config.anchor_rule: one distinct numeric C coordinate within radius; conflicting coordinates leave free corner fixed
postprocess_config.free_rule: lexicographic original-point representatives; nearest existing representative within radius; no transitive unions or means
postprocess_config.degenerate_rule: free only: exact repeated coordinate or exactly zero FP64 cross product
postprocess_config.duplicate_rule: free only: same three numeric coordinates ignoring winding; C wins, then first retained free source face

original_definition.C_sampling: MT19937 area-proportional face choice then sqrt barycentric; equal point weights; retain source C face index

ConflictCov_C.C_border: Exact C-only undirected coordinate-edge incidence=1;no welding
ConflictCov_C.cross: Only proper CF intersection segments belonging to the sampled C face;strict finite-segment distance < rho_cross*L0
ConflictCov_C.dup: Existence among all nondegenerate near-parallel free triangles;not normal of the globally nearest triangle
ConflictCov_C.reference: Same queries and rules on GT free;raw minus GT signed difference;do not assume GT zero
ConflictCov_C.unknown: Lower bound from confirmed union;upper adds affected unresolved pairs/undefined normals;PARTIAL if unknown can change sampled coverage

ExposedRetain.NA: No definitely reference-exposed samples;unknown denominator does not silently become zero
ExposedRetain.coincident: Near-zero finite free hits and potentially relevant coplanar/degenerate rays are UNKNOWN;face order never breaks ties
ExposedRetain.global_bounds: Additional conservative ratio bounds allow reference-unknown eligibility/directions;invalid C query normals widen this auxiliary interval to [0,1];not an extra primary score
ExposedRetain.ignore: Own source C face only;other near-zero surface hits are not discarded
ExposedRetain.lower: At least one definitely reference-visible direction stays definitely visible
ExposedRetain.origin: q+1e-7*d;positive intersections equivalently test unshifted ray t>1e-7
ExposedRetain.reference: At least one definitely visible direction in full C union GTfree;unknown reference eligibility separately reported
ExposedRetain.rejected_determinant: Any numerically rejected finite ray/triangle test with a forward ray-AABB possibility is UNKNOWN, without assuming the triangle is parallel
ExposedRetain.upper: On the same definite-reference denominator, at least one definitely reference-visible direction is visible or unresolved

SeamCov.CF: The edge owner free face against this Gamma edge owner C face only;old independently verified classifier;proper/coplanar-illegal/unresolved excluded
SeamCov.gamma: Whole trusted GT interface only;64/256 uniform midpoints with length/count weights
SeamCov.projection: Query projection along its GT edge tangent lies inside the finite predicted endpoint interval;zero interval slack

original_definition.dense_directions: Original26 then lexicographically sorted signed permutations of (2,1,0) and (2,1,1);26+24+24=74
original_definition.limits: Tolerance coverage, numerical conflict bands, and fixed-direction exposure;not topology/watertightness/penetration volume

quality_definition.scale_source: Fixed canonical training cube diagonal sqrt(3)*2/.3762; unchanged from RAW
quality_definition.stage: POST with preserved ordered C prefix; variable actual free-face count
quality_definition.CF_FF: Unmodified complete independently verified original pair_scan, all C/F and unique F/F pairs
quality_definition.denominator: CF/FF affected-free fractions use actual POST len(F); I retains full original C2048 query weight
quality_definition.I: Original ConflictCov_C cross/dup union, bounds, uncertainty and low-support status
quality_definition.queries: Read exact frozen per-condition C2048 NPZ and verify file/array hashes; never resample
quality_definition.small_angles: Unmodified shape_quality; free minimum triangle angle strictly <5 degrees
quality_definition.topology: Not inferred here; actual indexed topology must be reported separately by caller
quality_definition.empty_free_extension: Zero pair/area counts; free-face fractions NA with denominator0; I computed with frozen C queries and empty F

source_face_identity: Original fixed RAW face ordinal; source-corner identities preserved by GEO
topology_definition: Exactly two incident nonzero-area nonduplicate faces; at least one free; frozen pair class is resolved legal, not positive-area overlap. Winding reported separately.
reachable_area_definition: BFS in the valid C/F and F/F edge graph seeded with every C face; reached free area / all free area. C/C edges unnecessary because all C faces are seeds. Not semantic body identification.
additional_GEO_sensitivity: Source-face deletion, exact C-endpoint valid-edge loss/new, actual corner target/status changes, and input point-pair radius membership crossings. Crossings explain sensitivity; do not attribute causality through greedy representative selection.

distillation.denominator: 9 * number of valid free faces; C excluded
distillation.E: sum squared residual error / free scalar count
distillation.B: sum squared teacher effective residual / free scalar count
distillation.R: E/B; identity R=1 only when B>1e-14
distillation.pooling: pooled E and B use all free scalars; pooled R=sum error SSE/sum teacher energy, subject to the same pooled B low-signal rule
distillation.vector_cosine: one flattened free residual vector; NA for low teacher signal or zero student energy
distillation.corner_distance: Euclidean norm of each free corner displacement, quantiles over corners
distillation.synthetic_target: same-shape diagnostic only, FP64 difference of saved FP32 proposal and target; never real DEV reconstruction
